title: Vitest workers and their weston compositors survive the test run
note: Observed 2026-08-11 on this machine: 23 orphaned vitest fork workers and 8 orphaned weston compositors, aged up to 4 days, all reparented to the container init. Unconfirmed whether a clean run leaks or only an interrupted one. Measure with .bughunt/count-strays.sh before and after a clean run, an interrupted run, and a run whose worker aborts on a fatal critical.
